description: Axe 3 (capstone) — Intégration : lie les 3 axes en câblant ranking_model (scoring), context_retrieval (references), llm_agent (explication) et le contexte enrichi dans recommendation_agent + orchestrator. C'est le point de jonction où les 3 axes se rencontrent via ctx_vec. Calcul de ctx_vec + references UNE fois dans l'orchestrateur avant la closure generate (review-F1, review-F13) ; run accepte un ctx_vec optionnel (s'il est None, dérive weather_band de temperature puis calcule ctx_vec — résolution de la tension design/review). Backward compatible : kwargs optionnels, tests existants verts sur le chemin fallback (conftest). Dépend de FEAT-001 (config, occasions, conftest), FEAT-002 (ranking_model), FEAT-003 (context_retrieval), FEAT-004 (llm_agent.explain_outfit, context_agent enrichi).
steps: Modifier backend/app/agents/recommendation_agent.py run : ajouter kwargs optionnels rétro-compatibles `season=None, temperature=None, weather=None, occasion_category=None, formality=None, references=None, ctx_vec=None` (tous défaut None ; **kwargs déjà présent). Début de run : `from app.services import occasions; from app.ml import ranking_model; from app.core.config import get_settings`. Si ctx_vec is None : `weather_band = occasions.weather_band(temperature); ctx_vec = ranking_model.context_vector(occasion_category, season, weather_band)` (résolution review-F1/F3 — weather_band toujours dérivé de temperature, jamais un kwarg) ; sinon utiliser le ctx_vec fourni. Calcul visual_coherence (mean pairwise, INCHANGÉ) et génération de candidats (INCHANGÉS). Pour chaque candidat : `context_fit = float(np.mean(outfit_vecs, axis=0) @ ctx_vec)` ; `season_compat = sum(1 for it in outfit if seasons.season_compatible(getattr(it,'season',None), season))/len(outfit)` (getattr review-F2a — _FakeItem n'a pas season) ; `history_fit = max((float(ref['vec'] @ np.mean(outfit_vecs,axis=0)) for ref in (references or {}).get('historical',[])), default=0.0)` (utilise 'vec' retourné, pas de re-fetch review-F4) ; `recent` = compte entier existant (INCHANGÉ) ; `style_match` booléen existant (INCHANGÉ). `score = ranking_model.score_outfit(visual=visual_score, context_fit=context_fit, history_fit=history_fit, season_compat=season_compat, style_match=style_match, recent=recent, ranking_enabled=get_settings().ranking_enabled)`. Erreur pendant le calcul des features d'un outfit → try/except par candidat → score heuristique (ranking_model.score_outfit avec ranking_enabled=False) + WARNING (non fatal).

Dans recommendation_agent.py run : explication. Ajouter paramètre injecté `llm_agent=None` (défaut None — pas de LLM si non injecté). Si llm_agent est fourni : construire `facts = {'items':[...], 'scores':{...}, 'context':{...}, 'references': references}` et `expl = llm_agent.explain_outfit(facts)` ; si expl est une chaîne non vide → `explanation = expl[:2048]` (troncation review-F7). Sinon (llm_agent None OU expl None) → `_explain(...)` template (CONSERVÉ) enrichi d'une note d'ajustement déterministe repliée dans explanation : si `weather_band=='chaud'` et un item de catégorie 'bas' a `getattr(item,'season',None)=='hiver'` → ajouter ' (il fera chaud : remplace le bas par une pièce plus légère)'. Ajustements repliés dans explanation (pas de nouvelle colonne — décision schéma du design).

Modifier backend/app/agents/orchestrator.py recommend_outfits : après `context = self.context_agent.run(...)` (maintenant enrichi) et AVANT la closure generate (review-F1, review-F13) : `from app.services import occasions; from app.ml import ranking_model; from app.rag import context_retrieval; from app.core.config import get_settings`. `weather_band = occasions.weather_band(context.get('temperature')); ctx_vec = ranking_model.context_vector(context.get('occasion_category'), context.get('season'), weather_band)`. `if get_settings().contextual_rag_enabled: references = context_retrieval.retrieve_references(self.db, user_id, context, ctx_vec) else: references = None`. La closure `generate(items)` appelle `self.recommendation_agent.run(wardrobe_items=items, occasion=context['occasion'], favorite_styles=style_profile['favorite_styles'], usage=usage, season=context.get('season'), temperature=context.get('temperature'), weather=context.get('weather'), occasion_category=context.get('occasion_category'), formality=context.get('formality'), references=references, ctx_vec=ctx_vec, llm_agent=self.llm_agent)` — PAS weather_band (review-F1). Ajouter `self.llm_agent = LLMAgent()` dans __init__ (import LLMAgent) et le passer à run. Bloc dédup/insertion Outfit INCHANGÉ (explanation déjà tronqué côté run).

Mettre à jour backend/.env.example : ajouter (commentés) `# Kill-switches (default true): ranking model appris + RAG contextuel ; false -> heuristique/règles existantes exactes` puis `RANKING_ENABLED=true` et `CONTEXTUAL_RAG_ENABLED=true`, et documenter `# LLM (optional, free tier Mistral): LLM_PROVIDER=mistral + LLM_API_KEY pour activer parsing occasion + explications naturelles ; none (défaut) -> règles + templates`. Garder LLM_PROVIDER=none par défaut dans l'exemple.

Étendre backend/tests/test_recommendation_agent.py : sur le chemin fallback par défaut (conftest flags False), tests existants INCHANGÉS et VERTS (assertion -1 <= score <= 1 reste vraie ; test_favorite_style_bonus_breaks_a_tie reste vert — bonus style déterministe). Nouveaux cas : (a) ranking_enabled=True via monkeypatch.setenv('RANKING_ENABLED','true')+get_settings.cache_clear() + faux modèle sklearn (joblib.dump fake clf + monkeypatch ranking_model.MODEL_PATH + _load_model.cache_clear) : un outfit cohérent avec le contexte (context_fit haut) bat un outfit visuellement équivalent mais hors-contexte à visuel constant ; (b) LLM off (llm_agent=None) → explication template (contient 'match') ; (c) LLM mocké (injecter un mock LLMAgent avec explain_outfit renvoyant 'LLM expliqué') → explication == 'LLM expliqué' (et tronquée si >2048).
acceptance_criteria: `cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent.py -q` passe : tests existants verts sur le chemin fallback + nouveaux cas (ranking-enabled respecte context_fit ; LLM off → template ; LLM mocké → explication injectée tronquée).
`cd backend ; python -m pytest tests -q` passe (suite complète : existants + nouveaux de tous les FEAT).
recommendation_agent.run garde sa signature rétro-compatible (tous les nouveaux kwargs optionnels, défaut None ; tests existants qui n'en passent aucun restent verts).
L'orchestrateur calcule ctx_vec et references UNE fois avant la closure generate (pas de double calcul) ; weather_band n'est PAS passé à run (review-F1).
Les routes recommendations.py et le schéma OutfitRecommendationResult ne sont pas modifiés (context: dict absorbe les nouvelles clés).
verification: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests -q  # FULL suite — must be all green
findings: COMPLETED. Files modified: backend/app/agents/recommendation_agent.py (run gains optional backward-compatible kwargs + ctx_vec resolution + per-candidate contextual features via ranking_model.score_outfit + try/except heuristic fallback + _build_explanation/_references_for_llm helpers), backend/app/agents/orchestrator.py (computes ctx_vec + references ONCE before the generate closure; owns+injects LLMAgent), backend/.env.example (documents the LLM axes + RANKING_ENABLED/CONTEXTUAL_RAG_ENABLED kill-switches). NOT modified per design: backend/app/api/routes/recommendations.py and backend/app/schemas/outfit.py — OutfitRecommendationResult.context: dict absorbs the new keys. || EXACT run kwargs (recommendation_agent.run): all optional, default None, backward-compatible — season, temperature, weather, occasion_category, formality, references, ctx_vec, llm_agent (plus existing wardrobe_items/occasion/favorite_styles/top_k/usage/today/**kwargs). weather_band is NEVER a kwarg (review-F1/F3): always derived at the top via occasions.weather_band(temperature), so it is available for both ctx_vec lookup and the deterministic explanation note. If ctx_vec is None (direct calls/tests): ctx_vec = ranking_model.context_vector(occasion_category, season, weather_band); if provided (orchestrator path): used directly, no recompute (review-F1). ranking_enabled = get_settings().ranking_enabled is read at runtime inside run so the conftest cache_clear takes effect (review-F2). historical = (references or {}).get('historical', []) if references else []. || PER-CANDIDATE (visual_score/style_match/recent and candidate generation + optional-slot greedy fill UNCHANGED): inside try — outfit_mean=np.mean(outfit_vecs,axis=0); context_fit=float(outfit_mean @ ctx_vec); season_compat=sum(1 for it in outfit if seasons.season_compatible(getattr(it,'season',None), season))/len(outfit) (getattr review-F2a, _FakeItem has no season); history_fit=max((float(ref['vec'] @ outfit_mean) for ref in historical), default=0.0) (uses ref['vec'] returned by context_retrieval, NO Pinecone re-fetch, review-F4); score=ranking_model.score_outfit(visual=, context_fit=, history_fit=, season_compat=, style_match=, recent=, ranking_enabled=). except -> non-fatal WARNING + heuristic for this outfit via score_outfit(ranking_enabled=False). Fallback path (ranking_enabled False OR MODEL_PATH absent) ignores the contextual features = the exact existing heuristic (review-F12), so existing tests stay byte-for-byte green. || EXPLANATION (_build_explanation, truncated [:2048] on BOTH paths, review-F7): if llm_agent injected — facts={items:[{category,season}], scores:{relevance}, context:{occasion,occasion_category,season,weather,temperature,weather_band,formality}, references:_references_for_llm(references)}; expl=llm_agent.explain_outfit(facts); if expl truthy -> return expl[:2048]. Else (no llm_agent / provider none / expl None) -> _explain(...) template PRESERVED + a single deterministic adjustment note folded into explanation (no new schema column): if weather_band=='chaud' and any item with category=='bas' and getattr(it,'season',None)=='hiver' -> append ' (il fera chaud : remplace le bas par une pièce plus légère)'; then text[:2048]. _references_for_llm projects the RAG references to a JSON-serializable dict (strips numpy 'vec' arrays, stringifies uuid item_ids and dates) so explain_outfit_prompt json.dumps cannot fail when RAG+LLM are both on. || ORCHESTRATOR (recommend_outfits): after context=self.context_agent.run(...) (enriched) and BEFORE the generate closure (review-F1, review-F13): weather_band=occasions.weather_band(context.get('temperature')); ctx_vec=ranking_model.context_vector(context.get('occasion_category'), context.get('season'), weather_band); references = context_retrieval.retrieve_references(self.db, user_id, context, ctx_vec) if get_settings().contextual_rag_enabled else None. generate(items) calls recommendation_agent.run(wardrobe_items=items, occasion=context['occasion'], favorite_styles=style_profile['favorite_styles'], usage=usage, season=context.get('season'), temperature=context.get('temperature'), weather=context.get('weather'), occasion_category=context.get('occasion_category'), formality=context.get('formality'), references=references, ctx_vec=ctx_vec, llm_agent=self.llm_agent) — NOT weather_band (review-F1). __init__ adds self.llm_agent=LLMAgent() (import LLMAgent) and injects it. Dedup/Outfit insertion block UNCHANGED (explanation already truncated in run). ctx_vec + references computed ONCE (generate may be called up to 2x). || ENV (backend/.env.example): added an LLM-axes comment above LLM_PROVIDER (mistral + LLM_API_KEY to enable free-text occasion parsing + natural-language explanations; none default -> rules+templates); kept LLM_PROVIDER=none; added RANKING_ENABLED=true + CONTEXTUAL_RAG_ENABLED=true with the kill-switch comment. The conftest (FEAT-001) forces all three off/none so existing tests run the fallback path; new test (a) re-enables RANKING_ENABLED=true locally via monkeypatch.setenv + get_settings.cache_clear. || TESTS (backend/tests/test_recommendation_agent.py): the 6 existing tests are UNCHANGED and GREEN on the fallback path (test_favorite_style_bonus_breaks_a_tie still green via the deterministic +0.1 style bonus; the -1<=score<=1 assertion holds). New tests: (a) test_ranking_enabled_ranks_in_context_outfit_above_out_of_context — RANKING_ENABLED=true + a fake persisted _ContextRanker (joblib.dump, monkeypatch ranking_model.MODEL_PATH, _load_model.cache_clear) + ctx_vec passed directly to run; two single-robe outfits at equal visual coherence (1.0, since a 1-item outfit short-circuits pairwise compatibility) but orthogonal context_fit -> the in-context robe ranks first with a higher relevance_score; (b) test_llm_off_uses_the_template_explanation — llm_agent=None -> explanation contains 'match'; (c) test_injected_llm_explanation_is_used -> an injected mock LLMAgent.explain_outfit returning 'LLM expliqué' is used verbatim; test_injected_llm_explanation_is_truncated_to_2048 -> a 3000-char LLM string is truncated to exactly 2048 (review-F7). Added an autouse _clear_ranking_caches fixture + a module-level _ContextRanker (mirrors tests/test_ranking_model.py). || VERIFICATION: cd backend ; python -m pytest tests/test_recommendation_agent.py -q -> 10 passed (6 existing + 4 new). FULL suite cd backend ; python -m pytest tests -q -> 212 passed, 13 skipped, 2 failed. The 2 failures are the PRE-EXISTING environmental test_tryon_agent.py failures (ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'gradio_client' — missing optional dependency in this dev env; confirmed pre-existing on clean HEAD by the FEAT-002/003/004 findings, in the try-on agent which FEAT-005 does not touch). NO new failures: baseline was 208 passed / 13 skipped / 2 failed (same 2 tryon) -> now 212 passed / 13 skipped / 2 failed (same 2 tryon) = exactly +4 passing (the new FEAT-005 tests). Smoke import cd backend ; python -c 'import app.main' -> IMPORT OK.
